backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; accepted exp-20260520-004 trend-persistence broad-market adapter is the before state; after state adds an experiment-local avg_dollar_volume_20 liquidity-quality paper-notional scalar on the frozen accepted candidate universe.

gate3.note: No core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Within the accepted broad-market leadership paper sleeve, deeper 20-day average dollar-volume candidates may absorb momentum flows better, while thin liquidity may amplify slippage-like tail risk. A bounded liquidity-tier scalar can improve default-off paper allocation without adding noisy tickers.
interpretation: avg_dollar_volume_20 is a free OHLCV-derived liquidity-depth field. It is materially different from the recent broad-market path, score-gap, and correlation crowding surfaces, but because it still adjusts a frozen default-off paper allocation surface it must clear the strict 10% relative EV rule before promotion.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: Collect forward broad-market paper outcomes with avg_dollar_volume_20 metadata; do not retry nearby liquidity thresholds on the frozen sample without live replacement-value or slippage evidence.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation / candidate quality: broad-market paper candidates with deeper decision-time dollar-volume liquidity may deserve bounded support, while thin liquidity may deserve a haircut.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market rank-notional, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, score-gap crowding, correlation crowding, and path-cluster variants were tested; avg_dollar_volume_20 liquidity tier was not formalized for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only avg_dollar_volume_20 liquidity tier target/scalar changes; eligibility, rank profile, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, hold, slots, and frozen universe stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=8 adjusted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening, identity control, and >10% relative aggregate EV improvement.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, frozen candidate universe, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, liquidity tiers, adjusted examples, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Liquidity-quality notional support did not clear the strict three-window broad-market materiality gate.
single_causal_variable: 20-day average dollar-volume liquidity tier notional scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates

warehouse_audit.manifest_note: Partial warehouse is acceptable for this paper scout because the candidate set is restricted to all-window full-liquid rows.
